{{Top|leg}}
An '''Ionization Shield Generator''' was a type of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. It was part of the systems installed on [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms']] [[SD-9 battle droid]]s, located in the unit's chest. The generator created powerful [[ionization shielding]] around the [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
